title: The Gate behind the Ivy
story: In the town of Pell, ivy covered a stone gate that nobody opened. One evening Tamsin saw a silver moth land on the lock. The gate swung in without a sound. Beyond it was a garden under a sky full of stars. Flowers glowed when Tamsin stepped near them. A hare with a bell on its neck led her to a pool. The water showed her street, but the moon there was green. Tamsin filled a cup and the picture faded. The hare nodded toward the gate. She understood she could visit, not stay. She stepped back through the ivy. In the morning a garden petal was in her pocket.
